categories.name: Women's Trail Clothing
categories.description: Technical layers for hiking and everyday outdoor use.

faqs.question: How should I layer for changeable weather?
faqs.answer: Start with a breathable base layer, add an insulating mid-layer, and carry a waterproof shell for wind or rain.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right size?
faqs.answer: Use the size guide on each product page and compare the garment measurements with a similar layer you already own.

faqs.question: Can I return an item that does not fit?
faqs.answer: Unworn items can be returned within 30 days, with labels attached.

categories.name: Women's Waterproof Jackets
categories.description: Lightweight waterproof jackets for wet and windy days.

faqs.question: Are these jackets seam sealed?
faqs.answer: The Trail Shell has fully taped seams to help keep rain from entering through the stitching.

faqs.question: Can I wear a fleece underneath?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose your usual size for a base layer or size up if you prefer room for a thick mid-layer.
